title: The Gaze of a Higher Existence
next_chapter_hook: Those eyes beyond causality left one final words before dissipating: "The Heavenly Fate Eye was merely a chess piece I left behind in my youth. The true Chess Player has never departed from that dimension beyond your imagination."

text.content: The moment the guardian's final wisp of soul merged into the Tianji Record, the void around Chen Ji suddenly solidified. He felt an indescribable pressure surge from all directions—not spiritual pressure, not killing intent, but something more fundamental, as if some existence was examining him from a perspective that transcended causality.

The darkness at the deepest part of the ruins seemed to come alive, parting to either side to reveal a chaotic void. Within the void, there was no distinction between up and down, left and right—only endless profundity and silence. Then, that eye opened.

It was an eye that transcended all comprehension. No distinction between white and pupil, only a deep violet-gold hue, within which countless trajectories of stellar birth and extinction flowed. Every rotation carried a heavenly rhythm that stole one's breath. Chen Ji felt as though he had been pierced through—not his body, but his very fate.

dialogue.content: "Ten thousand years." The voice resounded directly in the depths of Chen Ji's Mental Sea, bypassing the eardrums, not occupying sound waves, as if heaven and earth themselves were whispering, "Finally, one piece has touched the edge of the chessboard."

text.content: Chen Ji forcefully suppressed the raging waves in his heart, yet his expression remained as calm as ever. He slightly cupped his hands in greeting, his voice neither servile nor arrogant: "You call yourself a piece, Senior. Could it be that you too are a pitiful creature manipulated by some higher existence?"

dialogue.content: A trace of amusement flickered in those violet-gold eyes: "Interesting. The first ant in ten thousand years to dare question me to my face." The voice paused, "Indeed, I was of the same source as the Heavenly Fate Eye you oppose. But I chose another path—attempting to overturn this chess game, rather than being a piece for a lifetime."

text.content: The space of the ruins began to crack under this pressure, countless tiny fissures spreading like spiderwebs. Chen Ji felt the Tianji Record violently trembling in his Mental Sea, as if encountering some existence of the same origin that was calling out. His heart screamed warnings—this was by no means an ordinary ancient remnant soul!

dialogue.content: "Ten thousand years ago, I attempted to break through the layers of chess games, and I failed." That eye slowly rotated, "My physical body perished, and my soul was sealed within this confined space. But I do not regret—for before my fall, I hid a wisp of will within this heaven and earth, waiting for the moment of awakening."

text.content: The stars flowed within those violet-gold eyes, as if examining every inch of Chen Ji's soul: "You are quite interesting. A mere ant at Foundation Building stage, yet possessing a fragment of the Tianji Record. More importantly... you carry the shadow of my failure."

Chen Ji felt a chill crawl from the soles of his feet to his spine. He understood that although this existence was merely a remnant soul, its level far exceeded his imagination—this was clearly a chess game of heaven and earth at another dimension!

choice.prompt: That eye transcending the Heavenly Dao awaits your response, radiating ancient pressure, each word carrying the power to alter fate. How will you face this failure from ten thousand years ago?

choices.description: Since the other party shared the same origin as the Heavenly Fate Eye, accepting their inheritance might gain key power to oppose the Heavenly Dao, even if hidden risks exist.
choices.visible_cost: Risk losing a part of your autonomous consciousness
choices.visible_reward: Gain the ability "Eye Beyond the Chessboard" to see through higher dimensional layouts
choices.risk_hint: The other party's words may not be entirely truthful—accepting the inheritance could result in being possessed

text.content: Chen Ji drew a deep breath, and under that ancient existence's gaze, slowly knelt on one knee: "The junior is willing to try." His voice was calm, but in his heart he was calculating rapidly—if the other party spoke truth, this was a rare opportunity; if it was a trap, he had contingencies.

dialogue.content: "Good." A trace of approval flickered in those violet-gold eyes, "You did not foolishly refuse like the others, nor did you greedily accept everything. You were probing, negotiating... This is what someone who can reach the end looks like."

choices.description: Even such an existence failed ten thousand years ago—why do you think you can succeed? Refuse to be anyone's chess piece, including this one before you.
choices.visible_cost: May miss out on fortune and offend this ancient existence
choices.visible_reward: Maintain complete autonomy without leaving hidden dangers
choices.risk_hint: Since this party came seeking you, they likely won't let go easily

text.content: Chen Ji raised his head, staring directly at those violet-gold eyes, a cold smile curling at the corner of his mouth: "Senior attempted to overturn the chessboard ten thousand years ago—what was the result? The junior has no desire to follow in your footsteps."

dialogue.content: The air in the ruins suddenly froze, that pressure intensifying severalfold. Yet Chen Ji discovered that rather than anger, a trace of... appreciation? appeared in those violet-gold eyes.

choices.description: Be neither a chess piece nor refuse the fortune. Attempt to negotiate with this ancient existence, maintaining the greatest initiative in cooperation.
choices.visible_cost: May provoke the other party or be forced to make certain promises
choices.visible_reward: Gain the inheritance while retaining maximum autonomy, and possibly learn more truth
choices.risk_hint: The other party is an existence from ten thousand years ago—their negotiating experience far surpasses yours

text.content: Chen Ji straightened his robes, cupping his hands neither servile nor arrogant: "Since Senior has the intent to pass down the inheritance, the junior is deeply grateful. However... the junior has one small condition." His gaze was冷静如水, "The inheritance is acceptable, but the junior needs to retain the right to say 'no.'"

dialogue.content: The flowing stars in those eyes suddenly stilled, as if the entire ruins held its breath at this moment. After a moment, a low laugh rang out: "Interesting... After ten thousand years, someone finally dares to bargain with me."

text.content: Those violet-gold eyes slowly rotated, as if examining every cell in Chen Ji's body. After a moment, a low sigh echoed through the ruins: "You are very intelligent, knowing what accepting the inheritance means. But what you don't know is... what I give you is not a complete inheritance."

dialogue.content: "What I give you is merely a seed." The stars in those eyes began to flow once more, "It will take root and sprout in your Mental Sea, granting you the ability of the 'Eye Beyond the Chessboard'—allowing you to see, beyond the chessboard, what other existences remain."

text.content: Chen Ji felt a warm force pour in from the crown of his head. That force was not like violent spiritual energy, but rather like a gentle stream, slowly seeping into the depths of his Mental Sea. Within it, a tiny violet-gold point of light was taking shape—that was the so-called "Eye Beyond the Chessboard."

The moment that seed completely formed, Chen Ji's vision suddenly broadened. He saw the broader heavens and earth beyond the ruins, saw the threads of fate connecting Tianqing Sect, Xuanwu Sect, and Holy Sect intertwining in the void—and at an even higher dimension, an invisible giant hand was manipulating all the threads.

dialogue.content: "Do you see it?" The voice carried a trace of exhaustion, "The Heavenly Fate Eye was merely a chess piece I left behind in my youth. The true Chess Player has never departed from that dimension beyond your imagination."

text.content: Those violet-gold eyes began to slowly dim, as if maintaining this form had exhausted its final reserves of power. "My time grows short." The voice gradually faded, "Remember, the Eye Beyond the Chessboard allows you to see higher existences, but you do not yet have the qualification to challenge them. Before that... survive."

Silence of the dead returned to the depths of the ruins. That eye transcending the Heavenly Dao had completely vanished, leaving only Chen Ji standing alone. In his Mental Sea, that violet-gold seed pulsed微微, as if having developed its own heartbeat. He knew that from this moment forward, his vision would forever be changed.
